_comment: Agent registry. Add a worker by appending an entry and deploying a matching runtime (Cloud Run Job, local daemon, or master-inline). No Master code changes — see registry.py and README 'Extending the registry'.

agents.name: echo-worker
agents.description: Placeholder worker. Echoes its input payload back as a typed result. Terminal — emits no relay messages.

agents.name: transform-worker
agents.description: Phase 2 second worker. Applies a text transform (upper/lower/reverse/count) and can relay its result through the Master to another agent.

agents.name: assistant
agents.description: Agentic assistant — a Claude tool-use loop that runs terminal commands on the operator's Mac to accomplish a natural-language goal. Read-only commands auto-run; anything else needs the operator's approval.

agents.name: mac-shell
agents.description: Runs shell commands on the operator's Mac via the outbound-only local agent. Every command is SENSITIVE — gated by the session window or per-command approval.

agents.name: cloudrun-admin
agents.description: Reads and manages Cloud Run via the Master's scoped service account. Works even when the Mac is offline. Read ops are benign; mutating ops are SENSITIVE.

agents.name: communities-scraper
agents.description: Scrapes new-construction community data (listings, pricing, DOM, descriptions) and writes it to the communities Google Sheet. Long-running Playwright job; mutates the sheet, so SENSITIVE.

agents.name: newhome-source-updater
agents.description: Refreshes the FL new-home community source list: adds new communities, marks sold-out ones, emails a change report. Mutates the source sheet, so SENSITIVE.

agents.name: sitemap-sync-weekly
agents.description: Weekly sitemap sync — builds sitemaps from the communities CSV in GCS and uploads them. Accepts payload.args to override the default CLI flags. Publishes sitemaps, so SENSITIVE.

agents.name: bing-daily
agents.description: Daily Bing Webmaster automation — submits URLs via IndexNow and pulls the Bing SEO report. Submits to Bing, so SENSITIVE.

agents.name: security-health
agents.description: Scans this Mac's security posture (disk encryption, firewall, exposed ports, credential-file permissions, remote-access software, secrets in shell history), grades it, and emails the operator a health report via SendGrid. Read-only scan; sends one email.

agents.name: security-probe
agents.description: Cloud Run job that probes the operator's own public web assets for risk — TLS cert expiry, HTTPS enforcement, missing security headers, and exposed sensitive paths (/.env, /.git) — grades them, and emails a report. Non-intrusive external scan; safe to schedule.

agents.name: incentive-social
agents.description: Scans the builder-incentives Google Sheet for fresh, customer-facing incentives (excludes mortgage rates/financing and agent/realtor bonuses), drafts Facebook + Instagram posts linked to the matching SE-Florida area page, and emails them to the operator for approval. Runs on the Mac via the local agent (the Cloud Run job was never deployed). Posting to Meta happens only after approval. Sends email, so SENSITIVE.

agents.name: crm-office-leads
agents.description: Office-Lead CRM agent for RealGeeks. Runs on the Mac (uses the saved RealGeeks browser session). Set payload.action to one of: 'daily_report' (pull the officelead-tagged leads, analyze needs-attention/activity/per-agent, and EMAIL the daily report to the broker), 'report_only' (build + save the report files, no email), 'verify_phantom_tasks' (READ-ONLY count of future-dated 2050+ follow-up tasks). Reads the CRM and may send an email to the operator; not destructive.

agents.name: crm-task-cleanup
agents.description: Office-Lead CRM cleanup. Runs on the Mac. payload.action='clear_phantom_tasks' completes every far-future (year 2030+) follow-up task — the phantom 2052-2055 reminders left by the buggy drip workflow. Proven safe (posts only internal notes, sends NO customer email; halts if any outbound email is detected). MUTATES the live CRM, so SENSITIVE — every run needs operator approval.

agents.name: jazzysphotos-site
agents.description: Updates the jazzysphotos.com photography site (the Astro repo on this Mac). Set payload.action. BENIGN, auto-run actions: 'status' (git state + pending changes), 'build' (npm run build to validate locally, no push), 'refresh_instagram' (npm run instagram — refreshes the Instagram preview images, staged but not published). PUBLISHING actions commit + push to main, which deploys to the live site via Cloudflare (live in ~90s) — each is SENSITIVE and needs operator approval: 'update_copy' (set a top-level copy field in site.ts, payload.field + payload.value), 'add_photo' (payload.image_path/title/alt/category[/featured/order]), 'remove_photo' (payload.slug), 'publish' (commit + push whatever is pending, payload.message). 'goal' runs a Claude tool-use loop scoped to the repo for free-form edits — its shell commands are gated per command.

agents.name: lead-response
agents.description: Lead-response agent for RealGeeks. Scans NEW leads, scores each (HOT/WARM/COLD), and DRAFTS a personalized first-response message (drafts only — never sends). payload.action 'scan' (default), payload.limit N. Uses the saved RealGeeks browser session; if expired, run office-leads/relogin.js.

agents.name: taylor
agents.description: Taylor — marketing & weekly agent reports for the Martin / St. Lucie / Palm Beach market. Builds each realtor (and loan officer Jody) a personalized report — customer activity, speed-to-lead, top-5 active leads, today's plays + live-flow activities from the Paradise Scorecard, a BeachesMLS market update (days-on-market, absorption, hot neighborhoods), our office listings, builder incentives, copy-paste social posts, and an AI tip — then emails it. payload.action: 'weekly_send' (default — full live pull; email EACH agent THEIR report and CC the broker), 'review' (email all reports to the broker only), 'preview' (build report files, no email). Uses the saved RealGeeks browser session + BeachesMLS (Spark). weekly_send emails real agents. Auto-runs Mondays 5 AM via launchd (com.paradise.taylor.weekly).
agents.title: Taylor

agents.name: joe-crm-report
agents.title: Joe's CRM Report
agents.description: Joe's CRM Report — office-WIDE RealGeeks operations report: metrics across ALL officelead leads (NOT split by agent). Needs-attention buckets (awaiting reply, new & untouched, overdue follow-ups, going-cold backlog, unassigned), a 24h activity recap, the per-agent breakdown, and recommendations. payload.action: 'email_report' (default — build + EMAIL the office-wide report to Joe; this is what runs on click), 'metrics' (build the report and RETURN the structured office snapshot JSON so other agents — e.g. Taylor — can pull office-wide CRM numbers through the Master). Subordinate to the agent master; other agents reach it via the 'office-leads'/'metrics' capabilities. Uses the saved RealGeeks session.

agents.name: joegpt
agents.description: JoeGPT — the public chatbot on paradiserealtyfla.com. Lives as a Cloud Run service (service name 'joegpt') at ~/paradise-realty/joegpt/, plus the in-process HFMaster sub-agent at ~/paradise-realty/hfmaster/agents/joegpt/. Replaces the legacy Zapier webhook; logs every session, message, lead, and handoff to Firestore (joegpt_sessions / joegpt_messages / joegpt_events). payload.action: 'deploy' (runs deploy-joegpt.sh — builds + deploys to Cloud Run us-east1; SENSITIVE), 'health' (GET /healthz against the live service), 'transcript' (GET /session/{id}/transcript with the admin key from Secret Manager 'joegpt-admin-api-key'; payload.session_id), 'recent_sessions' (read joegpt_sessions ordered by last_active_at desc, default 20), 'test_chat' (POST /session/start + /chat with a scripted prompt to smoke-test the live service). Anthropic key in Secret Manager 'anthropic-api-key'. Does NOT touch ~/paradise-realty/api/.

agents.name: joegpt-handoff
agents.description: JoeGPT human-handoff notifier. Wraps hfmaster/agents/chat_handoff.py and the Google Chat webhooks in Secret Manager (gchat-webhook-newcon / gchat-webhook-team / gchat-webhook-joe). Fires Card V2 messages with visitor name, contact, conversation summary, and a deep-link to the JoeGPT transcript endpoint. Routing is data-driven by hfmaster/routing_rules.yaml (business-hours new-construction → newcon, urgent → joe, default → team). payload.action: 'test_routing' (dry-run resolve a {topic, time_of_day, urgency} → space without sending), 'send_test_card' (post a clearly-labeled TEST card to the resolved space; SENSITIVE — real Google Chat traffic), 'recent_handoffs' (read Firestore 'handoff_events' ordered by created_at desc). Sends to a real chat space when used, so test sparingly.

agents.name: joegpt-migrate
agents.description: JoeGPT community-list migrator — replaces the old Zapier 'Master Community Landing Page' table with a Firestore collection ('community_landing_pages') that JoeGPT's search_communities tool reads. Wraps ~/paradise-realty/hfmaster/agents/joegpt/scripts/migrate_zapier_to_firestore.py. payload.action: 'preview' (read the CSV at scripts/master_communities.csv and print a row-count summary; no writes), 'migrate' (upsert every row into 'community_landing_pages' keyed by lowercased community_name; SENSITIVE — mutates Firestore), 'list_communities' (dump the current Firestore collection), 'refresh_cache' (call hfmaster/agents/joegpt/community_lookup.refresh() so the next chat picks up new rows without redeploying). One-time setup primarily, but safe to re-run when the CSV changes.
